input.observed_cancel_sequence: nonnegative-integer: acknowledged by domain settlement handler
input.observed_wake_sequence: optional nonnegative-integer: fixed claim observation, legacy default zero

atomic: release lease and claim authority; retain last holder identity as diagnostic evidence
an unseen cancellation forces immediate availability; acknowledged cancellation may back off while effects settle
an unseen domain wake forces immediate availability; heartbeat observations never acknowledge a domain wake
worker_job.defer.replay: same suspended fencing token, available time, and cursor; no lease or schedule extension

worker_job.request_cancel.suspended: request cancellation, retain suspended state, wake immediately for domain settlement; never mark an active external effect terminal

worker_job.claim_next.suspended: same priority/availability order as queued jobs; new claim advances fencing token and attempt number

invariants: Only a running claim with the matching owner/token and unexpired lease can emit progress or external effects.
Suspension is durable nonterminal waiting. It holds no executor or heartbeat thread.
Cancellation of a suspended job wakes domain settlement instead of completing unknown external effects.
The canonical runner invokes a registered cancellation handler before terminal settlement when a domain requires cleanup.
Terminal domain accounting settles before terminal worker-job accounting.
Claim, defer, cancel and complete update every affected index in the same transaction.
SQLite serializes the writer; PostgreSQL cancel, defer and automation progress hold the current worker row through commit; native OCC validates its current-job dependency.
Only the current backend epoch and backend-owned advancing clock prove or extend a live lease; delayed or forged caller clocks cannot revive one.

conversationPublication.atomic: Validate the bound job, user, kind, attempt, live holder/token and backend lease epoch/time in the same transaction as publication. SQL holds the worker row until commit; native records its OCC dependency.
conversationPublication.missingOrStale: database_conflict; no Turn, task event, replay or terminal accounting writes; omission cannot select legacy authority
conversationPublication.cancelled: Start is refused. A current claim may drain evidence and checkpoints only after durable startedAt proves entry; an unentered cancelled attempt permits terminal cleanup only. Cancellation never revokes the obligation to commit received evidence. Lost or expired claims remain refused for every write.
conversationPublication.flow: Visible phases and their progress/terminal events borrow the immutable root attempt's worker claim; caller-supplied root hints never grant authority.
conversationPublication.batch: Each entry carries the proof. Any refusal rolls back the entire batch including a valid prefix.
conversationPublication.legacy: An attempt with a non-durable binding retains its existing authority and accepts no worker claim.
conversationPublication.scope: Publication authority only. This does not authorize external effects or crash replay, and does not qualify conversation-attempt as a production worker kind.

conversationReplayPublication.binding: A conversation-attempt:{attemptId} task stream always requires its current worker claim, even when require_attempts_live is omitted.
conversationReplayPublication.owner: Standalone replay producers carry explicit user_id alongside worker_claim; batching retains each row's owner.
conversationReplayPublication.atomic: Validate the same worker authority inside the append transaction. Turn-carried replay rows use the enclosing Turn publication proof.
conversationReplayPublication.stale: Return inserted=false,rejected=worker_claim_stale for that row; preserve independent sibling results. Invalid proof shape refuses the transaction.
conversationReplayPublication.cancelled: An entered attempt's current claim may drain already-produced evidence. Without durable entry, only done, error and aborted replay frames may pass.
conversationReplayPublication.legacy: Non-worker streams retain their existing semantics; they cannot carry worker_claim.

conversationCancellation.reason: Human Stop uses user_stop. Internal cancellation serializes {contract: tofu.conversation-cancel/v1, reason, detail} into the existing opaque reason field, subject to its existing wire limit without truncation. The first durable request wins; local and remote carriers consume that acknowledged cause, not a later caller's cause.
conversationCancellation.admission: Stop commits worker_job.request_cancel before signalling a local carrier; registry absence never grants terminal publication authority.
conversationCancellation.queued: Retain the queued job and make cancellation immediately claimable. The domain cancel handler must commit the terminal Turn before transport completion; queued cancellation cannot orphan a pending Turn.
conversationCancellation.unentered: A current cancelled claim plus an attempt with no startedAt permits terminal cleanup without model context, prompt hooks, task registration or model/tool execution.
conversationCancellation.entered: The original invocation must join and discharge domain/account persistence, or recovery must supply that evidence. Lease ownership alone never authorizes effect replay or completion.

leaseAuthority.clock: backend-owned UTC-offset high-water plus monotonic elapsed time
leaseAuthority.lifetime: native/SQLite: existing shared store epoch; PostgreSQL: random named server-shared clock epoch scoped by database OID; never a Sidecar-local UUID
leaseAuthority.callerTime: now_ms is observation/evidence only; never a live-lease proof or lease extension
leaseAuthority.restart: previous-epoch claims fail closed and indexed recovery advances the existing fencing token
leaseAuthority.legacy: empty epoch is non-live; indexed recovery adopts a new epoch without rewriting user state
leaseAuthority.eligibilityClock: backend-owned current UTC; absolute queue availability never uses the advancing lease high-water

wakeAuthority.lifetime: bounded canonical job field; no wake ledger or resident waiter
wakeAuthority.authority: only an owner/tenant-proved domain transition advances the counter and availability atomically
wakeAuthority.claimObservation: captured at claim; never advanced by heartbeat or cached run reads
wakeAuthority.deferral: unseen wake wins over an older requested availability
